svg.title: ZoneFlow rev A, bottom side, assembly drawing at true size

g.text: ZoneFlow rev A, bottom side, seen from below (mirrored). True size.
Print at 100 % or "actual size", not "fit to page".
Check the print: each scale bar is 100.0 mm long, and the board edge is 114 x 110 mm.
Lay each part on its lands. Every lead must sit on a land and no body may cover a neighbour's land.
Grey: lands. Black: part outlines and designators from the B.Fab layer.
Circles: drilled holes for parts. Scale bars in millimetres.
